title: Legacy CRM Personal Suite - 3-Year Strategic Roadmap Overview (2024-2027)
summary: High-level strategic direction for the incumbent mobile CRM personal suite spanning 2024-2027, organized around five investment pillars that guide product development priorities.

strategic_pillars: Orchestration - Coordinating multi-channel customer engagement workflows across field, digital, and remote touchpoints
Compliance - Strengthening regulatory adherence for sample management, HCP transparency reporting, and consent tracking
Future of Work - Supporting hybrid engagement models combining in-person visits with virtual interactions
Connected Intelligence - Embedding AI-driven insights and next-best-action recommendations into field workflows
Platform - Foundational infrastructure improvements including performance, scalability, and integration capabilities
findings.release_cadence: Three major releases per year on a roughly 4-month cycle. Reference releases: R19 (March 2024), R20 (July 2024), R21 (November 2024)
roadmap_categorization: Technical Improvements - Infrastructure and performance enhancements
Enhancements and Contractual - Feature improvements and client-committed deliverables
Market Differentiator and Innovation - Competitive advantage and forward-looking capabilities
Interoperability, Integration, and Configurability - Ecosystem connectivity and customization flexibility
findings.migration_relevance: Understanding the incumbent roadmap helps identify gaps between current capabilities and what customers expect in a migration target. Items marked as stand-by or retired signal strategic de-investment areas that may create migration urgency for customers relying on those capabilities.
standby_and_retired_components: Cross-platform extension framework (stand-by) - reduced investment signals potential sunsetting
Third-party messaging integration (stand-by) - limited continued development
Regional messaging platform connector (stand-by) - minimal active roadmap items
Legacy call recording format (Call 1.0) - marked for retirement with migration path to Call 2.0

title: Legacy CRM Personal Suite - Component Roadmap Details by Functional Area
summary: Detailed per-component roadmap items across approximately 40 functional modules, organized by functional area. This granular view reveals where the incumbent platform is investing versus divesting.

account_and_territory_management.accounts: Account merge improvements, enhanced affiliation views, territory-based filtering refinements
account_and_territory_management.addresses: Address validation enhancements, geocoding accuracy improvements
account_and_territory_management.affiliations: Parent-child relationship visualization, affiliation type expansion
account_and_territory_management.account_plan: Goal tracking improvements, plan template configurability, executive-level planning views

field_activity_and_engagement.activity_history: Timeline visualization improvements, cross-channel activity aggregation
field_activity_and_engagement.activity_plan: Goal-based planning enhancements, automated plan suggestions based on customer segmentation
field_activity_and_engagement.call_recording: Call 2.0 migration path with enhanced attendee management, multi-product detailing, and real-time CLM integration. Call 1.0 flagged for retirement.
field_activity_and_engagement.coaching_events: Field coaching workflow improvements, scoring template configurability
field_activity_and_engagement.closed_loop_marketing: Content lifecycle management, engagement analytics, offline content caching improvements

compliance_and_samples.samples_management: Signature capture improvements, lot tracking, reconciliation workflow enhancements
compliance_and_samples.consent_and_opt: Multi-channel consent management, GDPR and privacy framework expansion, consent inheritance for affiliations
compliance_and_samples.data_change_request: Workflow approval enhancements, bulk DCR processing, integration with external master data sources

communication_and_outreach.field_email: Extensive roadmap with 30+ items including template management improvements, approved email analytics, personalization tokens, email scheduling, delivery tracking, fragment-based template composition, multi-language support, attachment handling, and integration with marketing automation platforms
communication_and_outreach.meetings: Virtual meeting integration, hybrid engagement support, meeting preparation workflows
communication_and_outreach.remote_engagement: Video conferencing integration, screen sharing for CLM content, virtual sampling workflows

intelligence_and_insights.insights: AI-driven recommendations for call planning, customer segmentation insights, engagement scoring
intelligence_and_insights.next_best_action: Machine learning model integration, multi-channel recommendation engine, suggestion prioritization
intelligence_and_insights.ai_assistant: Natural language query support, automated call reporting, intelligent scheduling suggestions

platform_and_infrastructure.home_page: Configurable dashboard widgets, role-based landing pages
platform_and_infrastructure.lists_and_filters: Advanced filtering capabilities, saved filter sharing, performance optimization for large datasets
platform_and_infrastructure.search: Global search improvements, search outside territory, fuzzy matching
platform_and_infrastructure.reports_and_dashboards: Interactive chart improvements, export capabilities, real-time data refresh
platform_and_infrastructure.notifications: Multi-channel notification delivery, priority-based filtering, actionable notifications
platform_and_infrastructure.planner: Route optimization enhancements, calendar integration improvements, multi-day trip planning
platform_and_infrastructure.document_management: Version control improvements, offline document access, annotation capabilities

specialized_modules.order_management: Order workflow improvements, pricing integration, order status tracking
specialized_modules.surveys: Survey template library expansion, branching logic improvements, offline survey completion
specialized_modules.store_check: Retail execution improvements, planogram compliance, photo verification
specialized_modules.generic_workflow: Configurable workflow engine improvements, approval chain flexibility
specialized_modules.wearable_integration: Smart watch quick actions, voice command support, car integration for driving mode

data_connectivity.master_data_connector: Synchronization improvements, data quality scoring, matching algorithm refinements
data_connectivity.booking_services: Meeting room and resource booking, calendar synchronization
